messages:
Maya Chen: FYI pasted the customer's email below — Bramble wants to onboard a 13B model for Kenya (Swahili + EN), requires data residency in Kenya region, HSM for keys, and a safety eval focused on local regulatory categories. Renewal in ~6 weeks, they're price-sensitive. Can we sketch a plan?
Omar Singh: Thanks — can you confirm expected QPS and latency SLO? Also do they need Hosted, Dedicated, or Private (VPC/on‑prem)?
Maya Chen: Copied from client: peak ~100 QPS, steady ~25–40 QPS, latency target p95 < 300ms. They prefer Dedicated reserved capacity in Kenya region or Private VPC if needed for compliance. Monthly estimate ~120M tokens.
Priya Patel: Quick safety followups: do they have sample prompts or categories to prioritize (e.g., finance, IDs, sexual content, political persuasion)? Any PII/PHI in prompts?
Maya Chen: They said mostly customer support and billing conversations (so PII present), and some regulatory Q&A (political/regulatory is relevant). They've shared a 500‑prompt sample set privately — will upload to our secure bucket.
Lena Ortiz: Renewal note: Bramble's contract ups for renewal in 6w. If we surface Dedicated with reserved pricing, there's a chance to reduce churn but be careful on unit economics — procurement flagged cost as main blocker. I'll take lead on procurement conversations.
Kai Rivera: For infra: 13B quantized to 4-bit should meet latency if pinned to GPU pool in region. We need to verify model variant compatibility (from the model catalog) + kernel availability for our Kenya region GPUs. Also propose a fallback smaller variant (7B) for burst spillover.
Omar Singh: Proposed CF steps: 1) run compatibility check, 2) dry-run eval with their 500 prompts, 3) 48h preprod soak at scaled qps, 4) canary to prod. Example eval command we use: ```
redwood eval run --model bramble-13b --dataset s3://redwood-secure/bramble/sample_prompts.json --metrics toxic,qa_f1,hallucination --output s3://redwood-reports/bramble/
```
Priya Patel: Safety thresholds proposal: toxic score (perspective) < 0.02, hallucination rate < 1% on the QA set, PI leakage detection flagged at token level zero-tolerance for raw IDs. We should mark this as high priority since PII in prompts is explicit.
Maya Chen: Action items for CS: 1) schedule enablement + prompt-crafting session with Bramble next Tue, 2) request the 500 prompts upload link (they said will grant), 3) collect a red-team list from Priya for localization-specific harms.
Lena Ortiz: I'll draft a renewal package showing cost delta: Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private and include a compromise for a 6‑month reserved with burst credits. Will need an ops estimate for baseline monthly $ and projected token savings from caching suggestions.
Kai Rivera: @omar / @deploy-bot can you check availability and kernel support in 'ke-north-1'? If no GPUs there, we need to plan for region routing + legal review.
deploy-bot: Reservation request created: res-8921 for ke-north-1 GPU pool (pending capacity check) :gear:
Omar Singh: I kicked off a quick capacity query — looks like limited A100 slots in ke-north-1, but we can provision with a 24–48h lead. If they need stricter residency, Private VPC on a supported onprem partner might be necessary.
Priya Patel: Also: localization eval — we should run toxicity + bias checks in Swahili. I can reuse our multilingual toxicity suite but need 200 labeled Swahili samples from them. Maya, can you request that in the enablement?
Maya Chen: Yup, I'll ask for the 200 labeled examples and lock time for the workshop. Also capturing feedback: they asked for a sample SLA (latency + availability) and an ops runbook for incident response — I'll attach templates.
Lena Ortiz: I'll sync with procurement today and update on budget risk. If procurement pushes back, we'll propose a phased rollout: 7B for warm traffic, 13B for high-value routes. That could cut initial commit.
Kai Rivera: I'll prepare a quick cost/latency projection for both variants and a fallback routing policy (model-size -> route) we can attach to the proposal.
Maya Chen: Sounds good — next check-in tomorrow EOD. @omar @priya please post any blockers here. :thumbsup:
Omar Singh: No blockers from SE yet, running the compatibility test now.
Priya Patel: I'll draft the safety checklist and share by EOD.
Lena Ortiz: Re procurement update: scheduled call with Bramble on Thursday 10am PT, Maya please join.
Maya Chen: On my calendar. Thanks everyone.
note: This thread is an internal CS intake for a customer model onboarding (Bramble). It captures operational asks, safety constraints, eval steps, renewal risk, and enablement coordination.
